5.Network of the largest Industrial 
Estate in ThailandWHAIR which is network of the largest Industrial Estate in Thailand, thus the WHAIR investment has been able to grow.
The industrial rental market, both for factories and warehouses, has benefited from the decision of many Chinese companies to
move their production base to Thailand. This move is aimed at diversifying their operations and mitigating the impact of global trade 
tensions.Gain benefit from global trade 
tension
Limited supply of ready built 
propertiesLarge players in the ready-built market have limited their new supply of ready-built warehouses and factories. Meanwhile, the 
business opportunities arising from the EEC would be able to result in inflows of business operators requiring rental space, driving 
up demand in the Eastern Seaboard area.
Diversity of total portfolioInvestment assets in various locations and more diversities in nationalities and business types of lessees possibly make amount of 
WHAIR’s income increase and give impressive return in form of cash distribution per unit.Development of transportation infrastructure, promotion of 10 targeted industries and investment incentives from EEC potentially
strengthen tenants’ businesses which will enable Thailand to continue being the logistics hub of the region and hence, positive to 
WHAIR’s performance.
Less impact under uncertainty Less impact from COVID-19 outbreak. WHAIR’s performance still strong over uncertain circumstances.
